name: WhatsApp Assistant
summary: Local WhatsApp MCP server and agent plugin with a graphical UI preview for Codex on macOS, selected text/media and separately confirmed replies, plus an opt-in private personal-Dot pilot through Secure MCP Tunnel.

release.scope: 0.3.1 private MCP App UI bridge and Dot pilot; UI resource and UI-only actions are opt-in through allowUi, while existing configurations remain UI-disabled by default. Local browser-panel reads and private ChatGPT status/search/read/preparation are verified; the native ChatGPT MCP App rendered on 2026-10-08 and showed connected status and German chat search. Real text sending, including through the personal Dot after the runtime update, was confirmed by the operator on 2026-10-03. Native Codex rendering, native UI history/media/send, live media delivery, reboot recovery and public hosting remain unverified

clientSupport.codex: primary target; historical 0.3.0 fresh local plugin installation, browser-panel rendering, connection and selected text read verified. The 0.3.1 local installation and registry/cache enablement are verified, and native ChatGPT MCP App rendering/status were checked on 2026-10-08. Native Codex rendering, fresh native Codex installation, native history/media/send and real UI send remain unverified

requirements.client: local Codex, Claude Code or compatible stdio MCP client

suitableFor: Finding an intentionally selected existing WhatsApp chat
Summarizing selected recent text using the chosen AI client
Drafting a text reply and sending only after a new explicit recipient/text confirmation
Separately preauthorized narrowly scoped scheduled text sends
unsuitableFor: Official WhatsApp Business Platform integration or vendor-supported critical delivery
Bulk outreach, new-number sends or incoming-triggered automatic replies
Model-facing media downloads, calls or full-history archives
Windows/Linux runtime installation or cloud-only operation without a user-owned WhatsApp host
Offline AI or a promise that requested data never reaches an AI provider
limitations: Text reads are selected-chat, paginated and bounded to the last 30 days; incomplete history is reported
Unofficial OpenWA/WhatsApp Web integration may break or lead to account restrictions

The UI adapter listens only on loopback; the separate private Dot pilot uses the official Secure MCP Tunnel and has no public production endpoint. Chrome connects to WhatsApp; selected text-tool data and explicitly selected UI content enter the chosen AI context
The host cannot cryptographically prove human confirmation or scheduler origin; bearer capabilities remain sensitive
GitHub source distribution only; packages remain private, not an npm-installed product
Own source MIT does not relicense OpenWA or other dependencies

evidence.automatedTests: The 0.3.1 candidate passes 162 local Node tests, 94 online tests and 17 synthetic browser cases on 2026-10-08, including real private-adapter UI, incoming images and attachment confirmation. Local listeners require host socket permissions. Strict release checks, frozen installation, all three installed security forks and the production audit pass. Two additional upstream dependency patches and a transparent local sprintf-js precision mitigation repair the newly reported advisories. Historical 0.3.0 CI evidence remains: all five hosted jobs passed on the repaired dependency and Chrome startup commit (8fe6e182bc369d6b915bc3d57b7a61d40af690d6, run 37098211435). The local 0.3.1 CLI installation/registry-cache check reports installed and enabled; the source-cache scan matched 109 source files after the third-party notice copy.
evidence.liveAcceptance: Historical 0.3.0 fresh local plugin installation and Codex browser-panel rendering are verified. Selected text read, names and one incoming image were checked without exporting private content. Synthetic PNG/document preparation and exact-file confirmation were verified without upload/send. Private ChatGPT tunnel status/search/read/preparation is verified, and on 2026-10-03 the operator confirmed successful real text sending in personal use, explicitly including through the personal Dot after the runtime update. On 2026-10-08, the native ChatGPT MCP App opened through Plugin öffnen, rendered the German UI and showed connected status; chat-list/history reading and native UI media/send were not exercised. After explicit authorization, the repaired dependencies and Chrome startup fix were activated in the installed runtime/cached plugin; the managed daemon reconnected to the same account and private MCP status reported connected with confirmed sending enabled. Native Codex MCP-App rendering, native UI history/media/send, media delivery and reboot recovery remain unverified. Historical 0.2.0 evidence remains in CLIENT_ACCEPTANCE.md
